newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy outlines Olivetti share thresholds.
newsitem.headline: Italy outlines Olivetti share thresholds.

text.p: The Italian Treasury, with the advice of stock market authority Consob, has issued new threshold levels for information technology group Olivetti, at which investors must disclose their share stakes.
A Treasury statement on Saturday said that the new thresholds at which investors must notify Consob of their holdings have been fixed at four, seven, 15, 20 and 33 percent.
For most Italian companies, the thresholds are fixed at 10, 20, 33, 50 and 75 percent. At these levels shareholders must inform Consob if their stakes reach that level or fall below the level.
A source at Olivetti said that the threshold levels had come down because of Olivetti's increasing status of a public company with a wide range of shareholders.
